# watchpoint_location_profile (Data Source)

Looks up a single location profile by name within the tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_location_profile" "primary" {
  name = "US + EU"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the location profile to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Location profile ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the tenant's default location profile.
- `is_global` (Boolean) Whether this is a global, system-managed profile.
- `region_ids` (Set of String) Region IDs the profile runs checks from.
